September 1, 2026

Democrats continue to have an edge over Republicans in vote intent for the November elections for U.S. Congress, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. 46% of registered voters say they will vote for the Democratic Party candidate in their district, and 40% will vote for the Republican candidate. That 6-point Democratic lead among registered voters is in line with recent weeks, and larger than the Democrats' low-single-digit lead for much of the summer. results.content:
In the latest generic congressional voting poll by Economist/YouGov, 40% said if elections for Congress were being held today, they'd vote for the Democratic candidate compared to 32% that said Republican. A whopping 29% said other, not sure or that they would not vote at all.

In Polymarket betting odds on who will win the 2026 midterms, the odds are now favoring a Democratic Party win in both the Senate and the House.
